Consequently it does not establish a physical Hilbert space, renormalized time-ordered products, causal pAQFT, a Lorentzian QME, scattering, or unitarity.

passages.text: The quantum story is equally layered. The strict theory has a nonzero local one-loop anomaly in the setting tested. A compensating field repairs that local identity, but changes the theory. At the causal level, the complete gauge complex admits a BRST-compatible Hadamard two-point **pseudo-state**. It has the right causal singularity and gauge identities, but it is indefinite. It is not a positive physical state, particle theory, or unitarity result.
